name: Heigl
source:
Exudes frivolity in conversation.
Formerly a reporter for a well-known news agency, he now works as a freelancer and always carries a camera.

After learning that there is more to his wife's death than meets the eye, he began to investigate relentlessly and discovered that all clues point towards ■■■■.
